mapper.sql: uc.id, uc.coupon_id AS couponId, uc.user_id AS userId, uc.status, uc.order_no AS orderNo, uc.used_time AS usedTime, uc.expire_time AS expireTime, uc.create_time AS createTime, c.name, c.type, c.scope, c.threshold, c.amount, c.discount, c.description
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND (uc.expire_time IS NULL OR uc.expire_time > #{now}) ORDER BY uc.expire_time ASC, uc.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS receiveTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unusedTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS usedTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiredTotal FROM user_coupon WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.deleted = 0 AND uc.id = #{id}
